title: Recommendation to approve an agreement with the University of Southern California Digital Repository (USC) for the digitization of the Board of Library Commissioners Meeting Minutes collection.
text:
[Board of Library Commissioners, Exhibit C]
Recommendation to approve an agreement with the University of Southern California Digital Repository (USC) for the digitization of the Board of Library Commissioners Meeting Minutes collection.
summary: The Board of Library Commissioners will consider an agreement with the USC Digital Repository to digitize the board's collection of meeting minutes.

details.action: Approve agreement for digitization of meeting minutes collection
